'''Pandaroo''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Pandaroot]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Favors lying down over sitting, and sitting over standing. Pandaroo enjoys swaying from side to side, often dozing off mid-sway."

Pandaroo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A round, white and green panda cub that appears to be perpetually sleeping in a fetal position.

Pandaroo's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces green with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Pandaroo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Pandaroot]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed Pandaroo 3 Sunshine Salads.

== Trivia ==
* Pandaroos bio description used to say: "When it grows up, it may take a red panda or tortoise as its master. For now, it's just cute."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "An adorable little panda, but 'Panda' feels to ordinary, so the name is Pandaroo. Whenever we can't think of a name for a Tatari, we tweak a word. What a clever shortcut."
